notes.title: Build Modes
notes.notes:
[list]
[b]Added[/b]
[*] Build Modes in the Build Settings Menu :-
    Default: allows placement exactly where you are looking and 
    Grid: Snaps object to a grid
    Snap: Snaps and rotates object based on object hit
[/list]

notes.title: New Objects & Sound Effects
notes.notes:
[list]
[b]Added[/b]
[*] Grave objects spawnables
[*] Sounds effects for progressive mode
[*] Ingame notifications to show you new unlocked items for users on progressive mode
[/list]

[list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[*] Auto apply material spawning objects at 0, 0, 0
[/list]

notes.title: Progressive Mode
notes.notes:
[list]
[b]Added[/b]
[*] Optional progressive mode, this adds a leveling system which locks some objects until certain levels are reached 
[/list]
